import re
TITLE = re.compile(r"^(?P<kind>[A-Z][a-z]+) '(?P<name>[^']*)'$")
METRIC = re.compile(r"^(?P<metric>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z ]*?):\s*(?P<percent>[\d.]+%) of (?P<total>\d+)$")
CREATE = re.compile(r"^Creating '(?P<gcov>[^']*)'$")
NOTE = re.compile(r"^No (?P<what>\w+)$")


def parse(lines):
    metrics, files = [], []
    ml, gl = [], []
    kind, name = "", ""
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            kind, name = "", ""
            continue
        m = CREATE.match(ln)
        if m:
            files.append({"kind": kind, "name": name, "gcov": m.group("gcov")})
            gl.append(i)
            continue
        m = TITLE.match(ln)
        if m:
            kind, name = m.group("kind"), m.group("name")
            ml.append(i)
            continue
        m = METRIC.match(ln)
        if m:
            metrics.append({"kind": kind or "total", "name": name, "metric": m.group("metric"),
                            "percent": m.group("percent"), "of": m.group("total")})
            ml.append(i)
            continue
        m = NOTE.match(ln)
        if m:
            metrics.append({"kind": kind or "total", "name": name, "metric": ln, "percent": "", "of": ""})
            ml.append(i)
            continue
    blocks = [
        {"name": "coverage", "kind": "table", "lines": ml, "records": metrics},
        {"name": "gcov_files", "kind": "table", "lines": gl, "records": files},
    ]
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": []}
